description: This Java source file defines the class ConnectionSignalIllegalException, a custom exception thrown when a connection command arrives during an ongoing connection operation. It includes methods for constructing instances, parsing from JSON, and a builder class for creating and customizing exceptions.

classes.name: ConnectionSignalIllegalException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception for illegal connection signals, with associated error code, construction methods, and a nested builder class.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class providing a fluent API to construct instances of ConnectionSignalIllegalException with customized properties such as connection ID, message, description, and cause.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance initialized with a specific connection ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers, parsing relevant fields.
